cont_jitter <- function(d, y, ylabel, top_sig = max(d[, y])*1.02, sigsize = 8, ymin = min(d[, y]), ymax = max(d[, y])*1.05) {
    jitter_plot <- ggplot(data = d, aes_string(x = "subtype", y = y)) +
                   geom_boxplot() +
                   geom_jitter(size=3, width=0.1, alpha=0.5, aes_string(color = "subtype")) +
                   coord_cartesian(ylim=c(ymin, ymax)) +
                   theme_classic() +
                   theme(text = element_text(size = 25)) +
                   geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("1", "2")),
                               color = "black",
                               textsize = sigsize,
                               map_signif_level = TRUE,
                               test = "t.test",
                               test.args = list(var.equal = TRUE)) +
                   geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("2", "3")),
                               color = "black",
                               textsize = sigsize,
                               map_signif_level = TRUE,
                               test = "t.test",
                               test.args = list(var.equal = TRUE)) +
                   geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("1", "3")),
                               color="black",
                               y_position = top_sig,
                               textsize = sigsize,
                               map_signif_level = TRUE,
                               test = "t.test",
                               test.args = list(var.equal = TRUE)) +
                   xlab("Subtype") +
                   ylab(ylabel)
    return(jitter_plot)
}

chisq <- function(dataframe, y) {
   dataframe <- droplevels(dataframe)
   dataframe2 <- dataframe %>%
       select(subtype,all_of(y))
   tab <- table(dataframe2)
   p <- chisq.test(tab)$p.value
   return(p)
}
